correctness.rationale: Uniformly elliptic angular generator has simple isolated 0 mode with spectral gap at least d>0. Bounded Feynman–Kac perturbation and an even Fourier recursion through modes ±2 give exact κ2/T and κ4/T limits; symbolic algebra independently reduces them to rational formulas. The unique optimizer follows from monotonic a(λ) and derivative of a/(a²+Ω²). At optimum, for Ω>d, S4=−3v⁴/[Ω(b*²+4Ω²)]<0; for Ω≤d, S4=−3d³v⁴(7d²−5Ω²)/[(d²+Ω²)³(4d²+Ω²)]<0. The branch boundary matches. Multiprecision tilted-generator eigenvalue tests and 350 deterministic admissible parameter cases corroborate these infinite-time analytical claims; script passed 2822 assertions.

value.rationale: Chirality and symmetric tumbling rate are a natural controlled active-motion parameter pair. Previously known optimization of variance growth gives no fourth-order statistics. The theorem gives a universal negative non-Gaussian correction at that same experimental transport optimum, while its magnitude encodes c2 not measurable from optimal diffusion. A concrete admissible symmetric turn law at nonoptimal rate has positive fourth-cumulant growth, proving genuine sign selection rather than a tautological property. This is a motivated two-observable tradeoff, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
